crime: {WITCH_NAME}'s mother left letters in a drawer, each marked "for later." She was gone within the month, and ever since, "for later" has meant goodbye.

In the prison, one girl went out to the courtyard fountain every evening, folded a letter to her little sister into a paper boat, and set it on the water. {WITCH_NAME} kept her company without leaving the lounge: she lay back on the sofa, stepped out of her body, and drifted out to the fountain as an unseen spirit. Every evening she told the lounge what the girl had written that night, and every time the girl laughed and said it was true.
One day in the dining hall, the girl put a letter folded into a boat in {WITCH_NAME}'s hands. "For later," she said. "In case I go first."

That evening, for the first time, {WITCH_NAME} went out to the fountain in her own body. As the girl leaned over to launch her boat, {WITCH_NAME} pushed her head under the water and held it there until she was still.

Then she lay still on the sofa, as she did every evening, only later than usual. At nine, she told the lounge what her spirit saw at the fountain: the girl was still there, folding tonight's boat. "The water's colder than it looks tonight," she added.
Before lockup, the prisoners found the girl face down in the fountain. In the trial court, they ruled that she had drowned after nine, while {WITCH_NAME} lay on the sofa the whole time.

Then one prisoner pointed out how her Magic works: when her spirit leaves, every feeling stays behind in her body. Her spirit could never have felt the water. The prisoners understood. The cold had been in her own hands, from holding the girl under, before she ever came in.
fields.epitaph: She never unfolded the girl's boat; she was so sure she already knew it said goodbye.
fields.epithet: Reader of Goodbyes Not Yet Written
execution: The execution stand raises a sheet of iron letter paper, with her chained flat at its center. Its hinged edges fold over her one crease at a time, each fold pressing down harder than the last. Then the folded iron letter stops shuddering, pressed flat and closed. An iron hand writes across the fold: "For later." An iron drawer slides shut over the letter, still unopened.

magic.name: Ghost of Myself
magic.text: She can step out of her body as an unseen spirit, leaving all its feeling behind.
